title: Sum of Digits
description: Given a non-negative integer n, return the sum of its decimal digits.
hints: Iterate using divmod or convert to string.

referenceSolution.python:
def solve(n):
    return sum(int(c) for c in str(n))

title: Sort Tuples by Second Element
description: Given a list of (name, score) tuples, sort it descending by score using a lambda key.

referenceSolution.python:
def solve(items):
    return sorted(items, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

title: Window ROW_NUMBER
description: employees: top earner per department via ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ...).
hints: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC)

referenceSolution.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT id, department_id, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rn FROM employees) SELECT id, department_id, salary FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1;

title: Recursive CTE
description: WITH RECURSIVE series 1..10.
hints: Base SELECT 1. Step n+1 WHERE n<10.

referenceSolution.sql: WITH RECURSIVE series(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM series WHERE n < 10) SELECT n FROM series;
